title: Quantum-Classical Link Prediction on Dark Web Hyperlink Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2610.32510v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We analyze HTML content and hyperlinks from an offline Tor crawl containing 383 onion hosts and 2,067 directed cross-host links. The study combines semantic analysis with degree-controlled quantum--classical link prediction. Two directory groups emit 94.8\% of the observed host links. Directed preferential attachment reaches ROC-AUC 0.976 with random non-edges, but falls to $0.550\pm0.014$ under source-conditioned target-degree matching. With disjoint training and test pairs, multimodal logistic regression reaches $0.672\pm0.021$, GAE $0.899\pm0.016$, and VGAE $0.906\pm0.016$. A four-qubit variational quantum classifier (VQC) comparison tests two encodings across 20 disjoint-pair graph splits under exact and 1,024-shot simulation, with classical controls using the same inputs and training examples. translated_title: 暗网超链接图上的量子-经典链接预测
translated_abstract: 我们分析了来自离线Tor爬取数据中的HTML内容与超链接，该数据包含383个洋葱主机和2,067条有向跨主机链接。本研究将语义分析与度控制条件下的量子-经典链接预测相结合。研究发现，两个目录群组发出了94.8%的观测主机链接。有向优先连接方法在随机非边情况下达到了0.976的ROC-AUC，但在源条件目标度匹配下降至0.550±0.014。在训练与测试对不相交的设置下，多模态逻辑回归达到0.672±0.021，图自编码器（GAE）为0.899±0.016，变分图自编码器（VGAE）为0.906±0.016。研究还比较了四量子比特变分量子分类器（VQC），在精确模拟和1,024次采样模拟下，对两种编码方式在20个不相交对图划分上进行了测试，经典对照组使用相同的输入和训练样本。VQC的最佳精确模拟平均ROC-AUC为0.549±0.023，相比之下RBF支持向量分类器为0.551±0.016，16参数的MLP为0.573±0.029。
tldr: 本研究首次在暗网Tor超链接图上系统比较了量子与经典链接预测方法，发现在严格的度控制评估下经典图自编码器表现最佳（VGAE达0.906），而四量子比特变分量子分类器与经典基线相比并无优势。
en_tdlr: This study provides the first systematic comparison of quantum and classical link prediction on dark web Tor hyperlink graphs, showing that under strict degree-controlled evaluation classical graph autoencoders perform best (VGAE reaching 0.906), while a four-qubit variational quantum classifier shows no advantage over classical baselines.
